findings.problem: The counted noun is dropped and carried only by the masculine adjective ending. Inside the tooltip (scope_chats_elsewhere) that is fine, because the same sentence has already said «непрочитанных чатов»; but this key is the TAIL OF THE ACCESSIBLE NAME, appended to a label that names no noun at all: «Отметить прочитанными: {count}». The full name therefore reads «Отметить прочитанными: 5, включая 2 неактивных» and never says what those 5 or those 2 are. This sidebar also lists agents, which are masculine and can be «неактивные», so the bare ending has a second possible referent for a screen-reader user with no rendered row in front of them. Not a meaning error (the reader still lands on chats); a native editor would put the noun back once, at no cost: the string is sr-only and inside a wrapping tooltip.
findings.suggested: , включая {elsewhere, plural, one {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} неактивный чат} few {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} неактивных чата} many {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} неактивных чатов} other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} неактивного чата}}
findings.suggested_note: Keeps the label a byte prefix of the name (WCAG 2.5.3): «Отметить прочитанными: 5, включая 2 неактивных чата». Cases verified per category: one «неактивный чат» (acc. sg), few «неактивных чата», many «неактивных чатов», other «неактивного чата» — the same forms the shipped catalogue.show_more_chats uses for чат/чата/чатов/чата. Apply to scope_chats_elsewhere's elsewhere arm too if the two are kept in one shape, though that one reads acceptably as shipped because its own sentence names «чатов».
